newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star raises $2.5 mln in placement.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star raises $2.5 mln in placement.

text.p: Lone Star International Energy Inc said Thursday it had completed a private placement with a group of institutional investors, raising $2.5 million.
The company said in a statement it will use the money to get two products into production and fulfill its backlog of orders, which totals $6 million.

One of the products is an energy-efficient mobile unit that can be attached to a diesel engine to transform the heat generated into energy for air conditioning and refrigeration. Lone Star explores, develops, operates and acquires oil and gas reserves.
Its stock was down 28/32 at 3-7/32 in early afternoon trade.
